title: Privacy & Security
topicSummary: Personal data and inference; purpose-limited collection; authentication and MFA; symmetric/public-key confidentiality and certificates; phishing, malware, network and permission risks; a 25-minute security investigation.
homeworkInstructions: Complete all 12 original questions (30 marks, about 40 minutes). Q5 requires exactly TWO choices. Use the stated fictional scenarios, models and simplified permission cards. Explain each decision with evidence; never enter or submit real passwords or personal details.
